items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: I'll tell him Mr. Russell, he never had swelling in the face.

ctx.x: Remember a friend of mine, Buck Johnson, always used Dr. Tishner's antiseptic. That's that, that's why he's Tishner's. Always rubbing on his lips.

Yeah. Always rubbing on his lips. Mm-hmm. Yeah. Carried that with him. Mm-hmm. And when he was at home he'd have a little piece of cotton, you know, and just put it on his lips like that little bit of a thing. I'll tell him Mr. Russell, he never had swelling in the face.
